title: Feature showcase: the pan
_note: Storyboard APPROVED 2026-10-25 (STORYBOARD_PROPOSAL.md), beat 6 (fryer) cut. Footage: kernel replay on the devlog stage (Tools/Devlog/footage/unreal/devlog_pan_shots.py via run_pan.py) and the Blender bench insert (footage/blender/devlog_pan_cut.py). Each clip runs 0.4 s longer than its beat so the 0.4 s fades do not eat the beat.

segments._note: beat 1, no caption: the cube lands at source 1.50 s (output 1.1 s), the sizzle ramp is full by 2.0 s
beat 2: -Z sears to 1 at source 3.0 s, flip 3.6-4.0 s (output 3.2-3.6), -Y done at 7.0 s. The cube sits centre-frame, so the caption sits top and ends before the flip
beat 3 (Blender insert): cut 1 at source 0.8-1.2 s, cut 2 at 2.2-2.6 s, four pieces from 3.2 s; the slab is centre-frame, caption top
beat 4: five cubes land 0.25-2.65 s, toss 5.40-5.85 s (two cubes hop 5.6 cm screen-right and turn a quarter over, their pools close and re-form, the trails lag); the pan fills the middle, caption top

captions.text: Every piece keeps its own pool

segments._note: beat 5: the -Z face runs past 1.0 to 1.9 by source 3.0 s while the fond builds; turned over 4.0-4.6 s (output 3.6-4.2) to show the charred face; caption top over the reveal
beat 7 (no caption): raw, half, seared, charred side by side, slow push in the footage itself
